create_psro_solver: create a PSROSolver instance to run the PSRO meta algorithm on an open_spiel game with a custom oracle
run_psro_iteration: run one PSRO iteration by calling update_agents and update_empirical_gamestate to evolve strategies
compute_meta_strategies: compute meta strategy probabilities using alpharank, nash, uniform, or prd methods
rectify_training_targets: rectify training targets to restrict which joint policies the oracle trains against
update_empirical_gamestate: update the empirical gamestate matrix by simulating episodes between policy combinations
